measurement_note: Size is U, the number of objects in an untouched branch while immutable-view creation and the rejected root assignment remain constant-time. Lazy proxying is independent of U, whereas a correct eager recursive wrapper processes all U objects. Both implementations finish all tiers and are separated by scaling.
